types.SM.sign_rescale_nonzero: SM.sign_rescale_nonzero (s a : ℝ) (hs : s ≠ 0) : SignType.sign a = SignType.sign s * SignType.sign (s * a)
types.SM.wall_epsilons_nonzero:
SM.wall_epsilons_nonzero (x y z : ℝ) (hyx : y ≠ x) (hzy : z ≠ y) (hzx : z ≠ x) :
  SM.wallLeftEpsilon x y z ≠ 0 ∧ SM.wallRightEpsilon x y z ≠ 0
types.SM.wall_epsilons_one_or_neg_one:
SM.wall_epsilons_one_or_neg_one (x y z : ℝ) (hyx : y ≠ x) (hzy : z ≠ y) (hzx : z ≠ x) :
  (SM.wallLeftEpsilon x y z = 1 ∨ SM.wallLeftEpsilon x y z = -1) ∧
    (SM.wallRightEpsilon x y z = 1 ∨ SM.wallRightEpsilon x y z = -1)
types.SM.wall_epsilon_positive: SM.wall_epsilon_positive (x y z : ℝ) (hzx : z ≠ x) : SM.wallLeftEpsilon x y z = 1 ∨ SM.wallRightEpsilon x y z = 1
types.SM.affine_line_difference: SM.affine_line_difference (p ω : SM.Plane) (x y : ℝ) : p + y • ω - (p + x • ω) = (y - x) • ω
types.SM.collinear_left_gate_sign:
SM.collinear_left_gate_sign (a b c r : SM.Plane) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≠ 0) (h : b - a = s • (c - a)) :
  SM.pointFarSign a r c = SignType.sign s * SM.pointFarSign a r b
types.SM.collinear_right_gate_sign:
SM.collinear_right_gate_sign (a b c r : SM.Plane) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≠ 0) (h : b - c = s • (a - c)) :
  SM.pointFarSign a r c = SignType.sign s * SM.pointFarSign b r c
types.SM.affine_collinear_left_gate:
SM.affine_collinear_left_gate (p ω r : SM.Plane) (x y z : ℝ) (hyx : y ≠ x) (hzx : z ≠ x) :
  SM.pointFarSign (p + x • ω) r (p + z • ω) = SM.wallLeftEpsilon x y z * SM.pointFarSign (p + x • ω) r (p + y • ω)
types.SM.affine_collinear_right_gate:
SM.affine_collinear_right_gate (p ω r : SM.Plane) (x y z : ℝ) (hzy : z ≠ y) (hzx : z ≠ x) :
  SM.pointFarSign (p + x • ω) r (p + z • ω) = SM.wallRightEpsilon x y z * SM.pointFarSign (p + y • ω) r (p + z • ω)
types.SM.geometricBoundaryArray_pointFarSign:
SM.geometricBoundaryArray_pointFarSign.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n)
  (g : ZMod n) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) :
  SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g t =
    ↑↑(SM.pointFarSign (SM.boundaryWord P g t.lower) (SM.boundaryWord P g t.middle) (SM.boundaryWord P g t.upper))
types.SM.boundary_collinear_left_sign:
SM.boundary_collinear_left_sign.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n)
  (g : ZMod n) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (p ω : SM.Plane) (x y z : ℝ)
  (hx : SM.boundaryWord P g t.lower = p + x • ω) (hy : SM.boundaryWord P g t.middle = p + y • ω)
  (hz : SM.boundaryWord P g t.upper = p + z • ω) (hyx : y ≠ x) (hzx : z ≠ x) (r : Fin n) (hl : t.lower < r)
  (hr : r < t.middle) :
  SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g
      { lower := t.lower, middle := r, upper := t.upper, lower_middle := hl, middle_upper := ⋯ } =
    ↑↑(SM.wallLeftEpsilon x y z) *
      SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g
        { lower := t.lower, middle := r, upper := t.middle, lower_middle := hl, middle_upper := hr }
types.SM.boundary_collinear_right_sign:
SM.boundary_collinear_right_sign.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n)
  (g : ZMod n) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (p ω : SM.Plane) (x y z : ℝ)
  (hx : SM.boundaryWord P g t.lower = p + x • ω) (hy : SM.boundaryWord P g t.middle = p + y • ω)
  (hz : SM.boundaryWord P g t.upper = p + z • ω) (hzy : z ≠ y) (hzx : z ≠ x) (r : Fin n) (hl : t.middle < r)
  (hr : r < t.upper) :
  SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g
      { lower := t.lower, middle := r, upper := t.upper, lower_middle := ⋯, middle_upper := hr } =
    ↑↑(SM.wallRightEpsilon x y z) *
      SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g
        { lower := t.middle, middle := r, upper := t.upper, lower_middle := hl, middle_upper := hr }
types.SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.positionSet: SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.positionSet {n : ℕ} (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) : Finset (Fin n)
types.SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.positionSet_:
SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.positionSet_bounds {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (x : Fin n)
  (hx : x ∈ t.positionSet) : t.lower ≤ x ∧ x ≤ t.upper
types.SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.vertexSet: SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.vertexSet {n : ℕ} (g : ZMod n) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) : Finset (ZMod n)
types.SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.vertexSet_in:
SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.vertexSet_injective {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (g : ZMod n) :
  Function.Injective (SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.vertexSet g)
types.SM.boundary_chi_nonzero_off_critical:
SM.boundary_chi_nonzero_off_critical {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (g : ZMod n)
  (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (hP : SM.pointZeroTriples P = {SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.vertexSet g t})
  (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (hu : u ≠ t) :
  SM.chi P (SM.boundaryIndex g u.upper) (SM.boundaryIndex g u.middle) (SM.boundaryIndex g u.lower) ≠ 0
types.SM.farOnlyOutput_local:
SM.farOnlyOutput_local.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] (J : SM.BoundaryInterval n)
  (H₁ H₂ : SM.TripleArray n R)
  (h : ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), J.left ≤ u.lower → u.upper ≤ J.right → H₁ u = H₂ u) :
  SM.farOnlyOutput H₁ J = SM.farOnlyOutput H₂ J
types.SM.farOnlyOutput_unchanged_off_critical:
SM.farOnlyOutput_unchanged_off_critical.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (H₁ H₂ : SM.TripleArray n R) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
  (h : ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), u ≠ t → H₁ u = H₂ u) (J : SM.BoundaryInterval n)
  (hJ : ¬(J.left ≤ t.lower ∧ t.upper ≤ J.right)) : SM.farOnlyOutput H₁ J = SM.farOnlyOutput H₂ J
types.SM.geometric_array_persists_off_critical:
SM.geometric_array_persists_off_critical.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (g : ZMod n) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
  (hP : SM.pointZeroTriples P = {SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.vertexSet g t}) :
  ∀ᶠ (Q : SM.LabelledTuple n) in nhds P,
    ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), u ≠ t → SM.geometricBoundaryArray Q g u = SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g u
types.SM.geometric_inverse_persists_off_span:
SM.geometric_inverse_persists_off_span.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (g : ZMod n) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
  (hP : SM.pointZeroTriples P = {SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.vertexSet g t}) :
  ∀ᶠ (Q : SM.LabelledTuple n) in nhds P,
    ∀ (J : SM.BoundaryInterval n),
      ¬(J.left ≤ t.lower ∧ t.upper ≤ J.right) →
        SM.farOnlyCoordinates (SM.geometricBoundaryArray Q g) J =
          SM.farOnlyCoordinates (SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g) J
types.SM.geometric_output_persists_off_span:
SM.geometric_output_persists_off_span.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (g : ZMod n) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
  (hP : SM.pointZeroTriples P = {SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.vertexSet g t}) :
  ∀ᶠ (Q : SM.LabelledTuple n) in nhds P,
    ∀ (J : SM.BoundaryInterval n),
      ¬(J.left ≤ t.lower ∧ t.upper ≤ J.right) →
        SM.farOnlyOutput (SM.geometricBoundaryArray Q g) J = SM.farOnlyOutput (SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g) J
